dct_description_sm: The purpose of this dataset was to examine the dynamics of sea-surface dissolved CO2, and the air-sea CO2 exchange within the ArcticNet domain, in the context of varying surface (e.g. sea ice, sea water states and location) and atmospheric (meteorology, micro-climate) forcing.  This dataset provides context for the various atmospheric, oceanographic, chemical and biological processes which were examined by the various investigators involved in the ArcticNet study.
dct_title_s: Ship-Based Sea Surface Dissolved CO2 (pCO2), 2010 ArcticNet, Northwest Passage (Aug)
